facts.value: Calls ftCo_800986B0, which requires !ftCo_800C5240(gobj), fp->x680 < common x250, and fp->x684 >= common x1C. On success, requires ABS(left-stick X) >= common x254. A stick-X times facing product >= 0 selects PassiveStandF; all other comparison results select PassiveStandB. Calls the private entry helper before returning true. Failed guards return false without local motion entry. Under ordinary IEEE comparisons, signed-zero products select F, NaN magnitude or threshold fails the magnitude guard, and an accepted unordered direction product selects B. No local input-range or finiteness validation occurs.
facts.rationale: Repairs negative-only B description and limits unchanged-state claims to the local transition behavior.

evidence.why: Exact comparisons, helper invocation and returns.

facts.value: For valid objects and normally returning callees, calls ftCommon_8007D7FC only when ground_or_air is GA_Air, then Fighter_ChangeMotionState(gobj,msid,Ft_MF_None,0,1,0,NULL), with animation start 0, speed 1 and blend 0. It next requests ft_800881D8(fp,fp->ft_data->x4C_sfx->x24,127,64), ft_PlaySFX(fp,3,127,64), and ftCo_SpawnEf(gobj,TopN joint,1,1053), in that order. Its caller supplies PassiveStandF/B; the private helper does not validate msid. Ground normalization can assert on an invalid floor reference. Exact audio/effect asset meanings and realization are not established.
facts.rationale: Replaces unconditional-success and unsupported asset/source labels with verified ordered calls and validity conditions.

evidence.why: Private helper, caller domain and complete entry body.

facts.value: Provides collision processing for the directional ground-recovery states PassiveStandF and PassiveStandB, not the separate in-place Passive state. It forwards to ft_80084104, which enters Fall when ft_800827A0 returns false.
facts.rationale: Corrects neutral-tech misclassification using the active callback table and actual delegate.

evidence.why: Separate Passive callbacks and shared F/B collision slots.

facts.value: Provides shared grounded movement processing for PassiveStandF/B directional recovery. The delegate multiplies ground friction by friction_when_above_walk_speed when absolute ground speed strictly exceeds walk_max_vel; the multiplier's configured value is not established here. With x594_b0 set it computes translation-Z times facing minus ground velocity as ground acceleration; otherwise it applies selected friction. Both branches run common ground movement. Stronger braking is not proved solely by the multiplication.
facts.rationale: Preserves directional-state and optional-branch mapping without unsupported claims about friction strength.

evidence.why: Strict guard, multiplication and alternative movement branches.

facts.value: After the prerequisite and inclusive horizontal-magnitude guard pass, enters the facing-relative PassiveStandF/B motion, first normalizing an airborne fighter when necessary, then making audio/effect requests. IASA is inert. Anim invokes ft_8008A2BC when the shared animation query returns false; completion can take boss-specific, DownSpot, special or Wait paths rather than universally ordinary grounded behavior. Phys delegates shared grounded movement. Coll delegates a check that can enter Fall.
facts.rationale: Repairs the universal completion outcome while retaining the complete local lifecycle.

evidence.why: Complete local gate, entry and callbacks.
